roads.name: Niagara Parkway
words: Sweeping and steady: 11 curves in 3.4 miles.
From 518 to 588 ft, with 341 ft of up and down along the way.
Water alongside for stretches.
11 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 50 km/h limit its curves ask for about 0.21 g.
